responsibility: Provides a minimal stub linemap implementation for the gm2-ici tool support build, supplying a dummy definition of m2linemap_GetLocationBinary so code linked with M2LexBuf can resolve the symbol outside the full cc1gm2/GCC linemap environment. Rather than performing source-location translation, this file deliberately reports an invalid call and terminates, marking the boundary between standalone tools and the real compiler-side location machinery.
